name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '05' is the chapter ID (chapter 5 sela-village init handler; chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), not an address residue (entry address is 0x33049, no _33049 suffix). Name accurately reflects the function's role as the chapter-5 init/prologue handler dispatched from the chapter-init table at 0x51d81.
purpose: Chapter 5 (sela-village) init handler: a flat chapter-prologue orchestrator that re-inits battle state, plays three dialog pages chained with two cutscenes (event ids 0x16/0x15), loads portrait set 1 mid-run, and pans the camera between scenes before handing control to the player.
logic_summary: Sequence (matches decompilation 1:1): fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); dialog page 0; battle_anim_phase=0; pan_cursor_and_window(3,3); delay 200ms; load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1); composite_battle_frame(0); delay 200ms; cutscene_event_trigger(0x16); dialog page 1; battle_anim_phase=0; pan_cursor_and_window(8,0xe); cutscene_event_trigger(0x15); dialog page 2; clear_all_chars_facing(); pan_cursor_to_char(0). battle_anim_phase is reset only after pages 0 and 1 (page 2 has no reset). No char init (party carried over from chapter 4). In the binary this function OWNS four shared alt-entry points that other chapter_NN_init handlers tail-JMP into: 0x3310C (chapter_11/18_init), 0x3312D (chapter_03/04/26/27/29_init), 0x3313B (chapter_30_init), 0x33140 (chapter_07_init). Leading __CHK(0x28) is the Watcom-injected frame-size stack probe, not part of the source body.

returns.semantics: No return value; chapter-5 prologue runs to completion then returns to the dispatcher.
